question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word:

 LUSTROUS
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Dull**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Lustrous"** means shining or glowing, often used to describe something that emits or reflects light in a beautiful way. (चमकदार)
 
 
• **Example:** The lustrous pearl necklace caught everyone's attention at the party.
 
 
• **"Dull"** refers to something that lacks brightness, shine, or liveliness. It is the direct opposite of "lustrous." (मंद या फीका)
 
 
• **Example:** The dull surface of the metal required polishing to restore its shin
